title: Open the diff viewer on two schematic files
summary: Launches the built-in WorkspaceManager:Difference process with DXP.Utils.RunCommand so Altium Designer opens two schematic sheets and lists their differences, with input checks and error handling around a call that returns no result.
phrasings: show differences between two SchDoc files
run a built-in Altium process from code
launch a server process with parameters

commands.name: CompareSchFiles
commands.description: Open the diff viewer on two schematic files
commands.params: Document1=<path to .SchDoc>|Document2=<path to .SchDoc> (from the menu without parameters: file pickers)
